structure: Overview: name the place and give one clue about the time (the clock).
Left side: the basketball hoop, the teenager shooting and the coach.
Back and middle: the man on the bench, then the people in the middle of the floor.
Right side: the woman on the yoga mat, then a short closing comment.
modelAnswer: This picture shows the gym at the Cedar Park Community Centre, and judging by the clock, it's about ten o'clock. On the left, there's a basketball hoop, and a teenager in a red jersey has just taken a shot, so the ball is in the air, flying toward the basket. Next to him, a coach in a dark tracksuit is holding a clipboard, and he's got a whistle around his neck. Against the back wall, there's a wooden bench with a couple of water bottles on it, and a man in a green T-shirt is sitting there taking a break, with a purple gym bag under the bench. In the middle of the floor, a young girl in a yellow top is skipping rope, while an older man with grey hair and a towel around his neck is walking nearby. On the right, a woman is sitting on a purple yoga mat, stretching toward her toes. In the bottom-left corner, three orange cones are lined up. It looks like a busy morning.

usefulExpressions.expression: Judging by the clock, it's about…
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Suy luận thời gian dựa vào chi tiết trong tranh (dựa vào… thì có vẻ là…)
Thì hiện tại hoàn thành để tả hành động vừa xảy ra trong khoảnh khắc của tranh
Chỉ vị trí sát tường phía sau
Nối hai hành động diễn ra cùng lúc, làm câu dài và tự nhiên hơn
Chỉ góc dưới bên trái bức tranh

commonMistakes: Nói 'jump rope' và 'skip rope' lẫn lộn thì không sao, nhưng tránh nói 'play rope'; dùng 'skipping rope' hoặc 'jumping rope'.
Dùng 'He wear', 'She sit' (thiếu -s/-ing); hãy luyện cấu trúc 'is + V-ing' cho từng người.
Tả quá lâu một người (ví dụ quả bóng rổ) rồi hết giờ; mỗi người chỉ cần 1–2 câu.
